subject.title: fix(azure): responses model aliases route correctly

question: Should configured endpoint/model surfaces be allowed to retain an alias provider owner except where an eligible manifest suppression unconditionally reserves the model for another provider?
rationale: This precedence decides which credentials and endpoint receive requests and how trusted plugin manifest claims interact, so code-level correctness alone cannot establish the intended permanent ownership policy.

options.title: Confirm the generic boundary and land
options.body: Approve the tested ownership and suppression precedence, refresh against current main, and merge after verifying the exact three-way result.

options.title: Narrow the fix to Azure
options.body: Replace the generic ownership policy with an Azure-specific repair if maintainers do not want configured endpoint surfaces to influence other manifest aliases.

options.title: Pause for provider-policy redesign
options.body: Keep the PR open while defining a different manifest-level contract for alias ownership, transport metadata, and suppression precedence.

recommendation.title: Confirm the generic boundary and land
recommendation.body: Approve the tested ownership and suppression precedence, refresh against current main, and merge after verifying the exact three-way result.
